verdict.rationale: BVNK is a payments platform with a Portal, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt file and the agent-wallet-cli are machine-readable docs and an external CLI, not an assistant inside the product, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
